subject: Math
skill: Nonlinear Equations In One Variable And Systems Of Equations In Two Variables
prompt: The function $f$ is defined by $f(x) = |2x - 3|$. What value of $x$ satisfies $f(x) = 7$?
explanation: To find $x$ when $f(x) = 7$, substitute into the function: $|2x - 3| = 7$. This absolute value equation means $2x - 3 = 7$ or $2x - 3 = -7$. Solving the first equation: $2x = 10$, so $x = 5$. Solving the second: $2x = -4$, so $x = -2$. Of the given choices, only $x = 5$ appears.
